[system.time](https://rdrr.io/r/base/system.time.html)({fit_rf <- [randomForest](https://rdrr.io/pkg/randomForest/man/randomForest.html)(x[, -nzv], y,  mtry = 9)})

```r
p_rf <- [predict](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)(fit_rf, x_test[,-nzv], type = "prob") 
p_rf <- p_rf / [rowSums](https://rdrr.io/r/base/colSums.html)(p_rf)
p_knn_pca  <- [predict](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html)(train_knn_pca, x_test, type = "prob")
p <- (p_rf + p_knn_pca)/2
y_pred <- [factor](https://rdrr.io/r/base/factor.html)([apply](https://rdrr.io/r/base/apply.html)(p, 1, which.max) - 1)
[mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(y_pred == y_test)
#> [1] 0.963
```
